fields.name: Speyside
fields.description: The heart of Scotch whisky production with over 50 distilleries, known for elegant, fruity, and complex single malts.

fields.name: Highland
fields.description: The largest whisky-producing region, offering diverse styles from light and floral to rich and full-bodied.

fields.name: Islay
fields.description: Famous for heavily peated, smoky whiskies with maritime character. Home to nine active distilleries.

fields.name: Lowland
fields.description: Known for lighter, gentler whiskies with grassy, floral, and citrus notes. Triple distillation is common.

fields.name: Campbeltown
fields.description: Once the whisky capital of the world with over 30 distilleries, now home to three producing distinctive, briny whiskies.

fields.name: Islands
fields.description: Diverse region including Skye, Mull, Jura, Arran, and Orkney. Styles range from maritime and smoky to light and honeyed.
